title: Auto-HSI: Personalized human control of a robot swarm on demand by using LLMs for online automatic code generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.16346v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper presents Auto-HSI, a method for generating personalized human-swarm interaction (HSI) interfaces on demand. The objective is to enable untrained operators to use natural language descriptions and gesture demonstrations to explain how they want the robots to collectively behave in response to their gestures. Based on these inputs, the code should automatically be generated for personalized state machines that will control the robots as desired, in response to the desired gesture inputs. In the developed Auto-HSI prototype, the generated code produces a personalized interface for centralized control using one- and two-handed gestures, enabling a user to teleoperate the robots' motion, formation shape, and shape deformation. We test the gesture tracking and code generation components of Auto-HSI against performance benchmarks. translated_title: Auto-HSI：利用大语言模型在线自动代码生成实现按需的个性化人类对机器人蜂群控制
translated_abstract: 本文提出了Auto-HSI，一种按需生成个性化人-蜂群交互（HSI）界面的方法。其目标是使未经训练的操作者能够通过自然语言描述和手势演示，来解释他们希望机器人如何集体响应其手势。基于这些输入，系统会自动生成个性化状态机的代码，该状态机将按照用户期望控制机器人，并响应所需的手势输入。在开发的Auto-HSI原型中，生成的代码产生了一个使用单手和双手手势进行集中控制的个性化界面，使用户能够远程操作机器人的运动、队形形状和形状变形。我们针对性能基准测试了Auto-HSI的手势跟踪和代码生成组件，随后在“实时”操作实验中测试了完整的Auto-HSI原型，实验中真实的人类操作者……（原文摘要此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出Auto-HSI方法，利用大语言模型在线自动生成代码，使未经训练的用户仅通过自然语言描述和手势演示即可按需创建个性化的人-蜂群交互界面，从而远程控制机器人蜂群的运动、队形形状和形状变形。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Auto-HSI, which leverages LLMs for online automatic code generation to enable untrained users to create personalized human-swarm interaction interfaces on demand through natural language descriptions and gesture demonstrations, allowing them to teleoperate robot swarm motion, formation shape, and shape deformation.
